title: Sword Art Online the Movie Progressive Scherzo of Deep Night
titleEn: Sword Art Online the Movie Progressive Scherzo of Deep Night
description: Sword Art Online: Progressive – Scherzo of Deep Night  is a 2022 Japanese animated science fiction action adventure film based on the Sword Art Online: Progressive light novels written by Reki Kawahara and illustrated by abec, and a sequel to the 2021 film Sword Art Online: Progressive – Aria of a Starless Night. The staff and cast from the first film reprised their roles, including production by A-1 Pictures and direction by Ayako Kōno, with character designs by Kento Toya and music by Yuki Kajiura. It was released on July 14, 2023.
